text: mode disabling dependent ExecutableEntity A mode disabling dependent RunnableEntity or a BswSchedulableEntity is triggered by an RTEEvent respectively a BswEvent with a mode disabling dependency. RTE and Basic Software Scheduler prevent the activation of those RunnableEntity or BswSchedulableEntity by the RTEEvent / BswEvent, when the corresponding mode disabling is active. See also section 4.4.1.

targets.why: prevents activation of mode disabling dependent entity
